dogecoin.text:
With #Bitcoin's resurgence and altcoins like #XRP and #Dogecoin jumping, the total crypto market cap has risen to $3.23 trillion. The crypto ecosystem continues to expand!

Which crypto are you bullish on?
Not just Bitcoin—#Dogecoin and #XRP saw jumps of over 13% after the US paused tariffs. Crypto markets are buzzing with excitement!
